tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently had dinner at a restaurant called Cozy Corner. While part of the experience was enjoyable, the service was poor. You want to provide feedback to the restaurant owner, Ms. Lee. Write an email to Ms. Lee.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about your dining experience.
Explain the issues you faced with the service and your order.
Suggest ways to improve the service for future customers.
tasks.subject: Restaurant Service Complaint
